title: Differential-adhesion aggregation of a dissociated two-type cell population (Cellular Potts, Morpheus 2.3.9)
scope: Simulated aggregate morphology under the differential adhesion hypothesis. Not a Xenobot, not any organism. No frog parameter is used: every energy, temperature and size is generic and dimensionless (lattice units, Monte Carlo steps). Cilia are not modelled. Contraction is not modelled here at all.

engine.name: Morpheus
engine.template: Examples/CPM/CellSorting_3D.xml (Graner & Glazier 1992 extended Potts), re-parameterised and re-initialised by engineering/xenomorph/cpm_model.py

initial_population.description: Dense dissociated suspension: the n sites of a simple-cubic lattice (spacing 2r+gap+2*jitter) nearest the lattice centre, each jittered by an independent seeded uniform +-jitter per axis. Neighbours along a lattice axis stay >= 2r+gap apart, so no two cells touch at t=0. Types A and B 50:50 by a seeded shuffle.
initial_population.check: at t=0 the contact graph must have n_cells components (verified by analysis, stored in metrics)
initial_population.revision_before_freeze: A low-density random-sequential-addition placement (ball radius 38, gap >= 2, 14% packing) was piloted first with seed 99 (not a protocol seed). In 4000 MCS adhesive cells formed ~21 local clusters that did not merge and Rg did not fall; the zero-adhesion pilot also formed transient neutral contacts (largest cluster 0.22). Placement was changed to the dense suspension above before any protocol seed was run. Pilot metrics are kept in results/xenomorph/pilot/. A second pilot (seed 98) with the dense placement ran 500-3000 MCS to confirm compaction begins (8 aggregates, rg_norm 0.75 -> 0.66 at 500 MCS) and motivated the zero-adhesion gate change above. No protocol seed was run before the freeze.

cells.volume_target: measured initial sphere voxel count (same for every cell)

dah.role: main: unequal adhesion (A more cohesive) -> compaction and A-core/B-shell sorting

surface_tensions.engulfment_condition: gamma_AM > gamma_AB + gamma_BM: 9 > 8, B should engulf A

equal.role: control: identical types; must compact but must NOT sort

zero.role: control: adhesion off. Contact carries no energy advantage over medium (J_xy = J_xM + J_yM for every pair, so every gamma_xM and gamma_AB is 0); the population must NOT compact

surface_tension_definition: gamma_xM = J_xM - J_xx/2 ; gamma_AB = J_AB - (J_AA + J_BB)/2 (Glazier & Graner 1993)

seeds.rule: same seed drives placement and Morpheus RandomSeed

refinement.rule: lattice size, cell radius, gap and placement radius multiply by s; volume target follows; J, T, volume strength unchanged; horizon and snapshot interval multiply by s^2 (diffusive rescaling, an assumption stated here before running)
refinement.compared: final largest_cluster_fraction, sphericity, sorting_index_homotypic, core_shell_index, normalised Rg (Rg / (N * V_cell)^(1/3))
refinement.verdict_rule: Report the change between scale 1.0 and 1.5 for each metric. A metric is called resolution-stable only if |change| is smaller than the seed spread (max-min over seeds 1-4 at scale 1.0). Otherwise the metric is reported as resolution-dependent, and no claim depends on its exact value.

measurements_per_snapshot.n_aggregates: connected components of the cell contact graph (two cells adjacent if any of their voxels share a face)
measurements_per_snapshot.largest_cluster_fraction: cells in the largest component / N
measurements_per_snapshot.sphericity_largest: pi^(1/3) (6V)^(2/3) / A of the largest component, A from marching cubes (level 0.5) on its binary occupancy, V voxel count
measurements_per_snapshot.contact_area_cell_cell: count of voxel faces between two different cells (lattice units^2)
measurements_per_snapshot.contact_area_cell_medium: count of voxel faces between a cell and medium
measurements_per_snapshot.rg_all: radius of gyration of all cell voxels about their centroid
measurements_per_snapshot.sorting_index_homotypic: (A-A + B-B face area) / total cell-cell face area; ~0.5 for a random 50:50 mix
measurements_per_snapshot.core_shell_index: (mean radial distance of B voxels - mean radial distance of A voxels) / rg_all, from the centroid of all cells; >0 means A core, B shell

controls_and_falsifiers.zero_adhesion: PASS iff final rg_norm >= 0.95 * initial rg_norm in every seed (the population does not compact). FAIL means the setup or engine is wrong and no other arm may be read. largest_cluster_fraction is reported but NOT gated for this arm: in a dense suspension jammed cells touch without any cohesive energy (dense pilot, seed 98: 0.46 at 500 MCS with Rg unchanged).
controls_and_falsifiers.equal_adhesion: PASS iff |mean final core_shell_index over seeds| < 0.1 AND mean final sorting_index_homotypic < 0.60 (mixing). FAIL marks a sorting artifact.
controls_and_falsifiers.dah_compaction: aggregation claimed iff final largest_cluster_fraction >= 0.9 AND rg_norm falls by >= 20% from t=0, in every seed. (A perfect ball of the same volume has rg_norm = sqrt(3/5)*(3/(4 pi))^(1/3) = 0.4806, i.e. ~36% below the t=0 value of ~0.75.)
controls_and_falsifiers.dah_sorting: sorting claimed iff mean final core_shell_index > 0.1 AND mean final sorting_index_homotypic exceeds the equal arm's mean by more than (dah range + equal range) over seeds
controls_and_falsifiers.equal_compaction: reported, same rule as dah_compaction (identical-type cohesion should also compact)

compute.production: Nebius AI job, CPU platform, 16 Morpheus runs in parallel, 1 thread each
compute.gpu_sweep: engineering/xenomorph/offlattice.py on one Nebius GPU (separate engine, separate config)
compute.cross_engine: PhysiCell 1.14.2 three-arm check (separate config, declared in its own file)
